import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/yazii/ynov_project/linter-python-flask')
label, *command = sys.argv[1:]
start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record = {
    'label': label, 'command': shlex.join(command), 'started_utc': start,
    'environment': {'platform': platform.platform(), 'python_host': platform.python_version(),
                    'cwd': str(root), 'DB_HOST': os.getenv('DB_HOST'), 'DB_PORT': os.getenv('DB_PORT')},
    'exit_code': result.returncode, 'output': result.stdout,
}
path = root / 'security-evidence/task-003/commands.json'
records = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else []
records.append(record)
path.write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'exit_code': result.returncode}))
print(result.stdout[-4500:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)

import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import urllib.request

root = Path('/home/yazii/ynov_project/linter-python-flask')
out = root / 'security-evidence/task-003'
initial = json.loads(Path('/tmp/task003-initial-resolution.json').read_text())
final = json.loads(Path('/tmp/task003-install.json').read_text())

def summary(report):
    return [{'name': p['metadata']['name'], 'version': p['metadata']['version'],
             'direct': p['requested'], 'requires_python': p['metadata'].get('requires_python'),
             'requires_dist': p['metadata'].get('requires_dist', []),
             'artifact': p['download_info']} for p in report['install']]

inventory = {'python': final['environment'], 'initial_resolution': summary(initial), 'final': summary(final)}
(out / 'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + '\n')
Path('/tmp/task003-initial-pinned.txt').write_text(''.join(f"{p['name']}=={p['version']}\n" for p in inventory['initial_resolution']))
lock = (root / 'requirements.txt').read_text()
blocks = re.split(r'(?m)^(?=[a-z][a-z0-9-]*==)', lock)[1:]
packages = [(re.match(r'([^=]+)==([^\s]+)', b).groups(), re.findall(r'--hash=sha256:([a-f0-9]+)', b)) for b in blocks]

def verify(item):
    (name, version), hashes = item
    url = f'https://pypi.org/pypi/{name}/{version}/json'
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
        data = json.load(response)
    files = [{'filename': f['filename'], 'sha256': f['digests']['sha256'], 'requires_python': f['requires_python'],
              'yanked': f['yanked'], 'uploaded_utc': f['upload_time_iso_8601']} for f in data['urls']]
    published = {f['sha256'] for f in files}
    assert hashes and set(hashes) <= published, (name, 'hashes absent from PyPI')
    assert not all(f['yanked'] for f in files), (name, 'yanked release')
    return {'name': name, 'version': version, 'source': url, 'requires_python': data['info']['requires_python'],
            'hashes_verified': len(hashes), 'files': files, 'vulnerabilities': data.get('vulnerabilities', [])}

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    verified = list(pool.map(verify, packages))
(out / 'pypi-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(verified, indent=2) + '\n')
print('All', len(verified), 'releases and all lock hashes verified against PyPI.')
print('Vulnerabilities in final PyPI metadata:', [(p['name'], p['vulnerabilities']) for p in verified if p['vulnerabilities']])
print('SHA256 requirements.txt:', hashlib.sha256(lock.encode()).hexdigest())

import json
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
p = Path('security-evidence/task-003')
audit=json.loads((p/'audit-initial.json').read_text())
ids=sorted({alias for d in audit['dependencies'] for v in d['vulns'] for alias in [v['id']]+v.get('aliases',[]) if alias.startswith('GHSA-')})
records=[]
for ident in ids:
 url=f'https://api.github.com/advisories/{ident}'
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'task003-dependency-audit','Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: data=json.load(r)
 records.append({k:data.get(k) for k in ['ghsa_id','cve_id','html_url','summary','severity','cvss','vulnerabilities','published_at','updated_at','withdrawn_at','references']})
(p/'advisories.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in records:
 print(r['ghsa_id'],r['cve_id'],r['severity'],r['summary'])
 for v in r['vulnerabilities']: print(v['package'], v['vulnerable_version_range'],v['first_patched_version'])

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

root = Path('.')
proof = root / 'security-evidence/task-003'
for path in proof.glob('*.json'):
    json.loads(path.read_text())
manifest = root.joinpath('requirements.txt').read_text()
expected = dict(re.findall(r'(?m)^([a-z0-9-]+)==([^\s]+)', manifest))
normalize = lambda value: value.lower().replace('_', '-')
inventory = json.loads((proof / 'inventory.json').read_text())
installed = {normalize(p['name']): p['version'] for p in inventory['final']}
audit = json.loads((proof / 'audit-final.json').read_text())
scanned = {normalize(p['name']): p['version'] for p in audit['dependencies']}
assert expected == installed == scanned
assert len(expected) == 22
assert not any(p['vulns'] for p in audit['dependencies'])
assert not any('skip_reason' in p for p in audit['dependencies'])
assert len([p for p in inventory['final'] if p['direct']]) == 7
provenance = json.loads((proof / 'provenance.json').read_text())
for name, digest in provenance['files'].items():
    content = root.joinpath(name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == digest
    assert content == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f"{provenance['audited_commit']}:{name}"])
report = root.joinpath('security-dependencies.md').read_text()
for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', report):
    if not link.startswith('https://'):
        assert root.joinpath(link).is_file(), link
assert report.count('```') % 2 == 0
for command in [['git', 'diff', '--check'], ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check']]:
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
forbidden = ['Dockerfile', 'docker-compose.yml', '.github/workflows', 'app.py', 'test_app.py', 'audit.md']
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', 'b9c1bf27b9c8dc9c1ba2c7c800eee6cd54f060e9', '--'] + forbidden, check=True)
print('PASS: 22 identical locked/installed/scanned packages; zero advisories; seven direct roots.')
print('PASS: audited commit bytes, SHA256 proofs, valid JSON/Markdown links and diff whitespace.')
print('PASS: Dockerfile, Compose, workflows, app.py, test_app.py and TASK-001 unchanged.')
